title: Regional Director of Pooled Customer Success
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

Location: San Francisco, Hybrid

ABOUT THE TEAM

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base. It is a team of a program manager, a content and enablement specialist, a success analytics engineer and a success operations manager, reporting to the Director of Scaled Success. The pooled customer success team is the next team to be added, and this role leads it.

THE ROLE

You build and run the pooled customer success team. Work arrives on a shared queue when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. The signals come from our configuration maturity model, which scores every account on how deeply it has set up the product, and from the automated campaigns that escalate when a customer needs a person.

You design the queue, write the routing rules, set the response standards, build the playbooks, hire the team, and measure whether the motion holds retention in the band it covers. You work directly with the Director, the Scaled Success program manager, the Success Analytics Engineer and the Content and Enablement Specialist.

This team runs on signals, and the help arrives when the customer needs it. The person who builds it will learn how to run customer success this way from the inside, and will have the data to show what works.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Hiring and managing the pooled customer success managers, starting with the first hires in your first quarter

- Queue design: which signals create work, how work is prioritized, the response and resolution standards, and how a case closes

- The routing rules between the digital, pooled and named lanes, including the escalation path out of digital and the hand-back when an account grows into named coverage

- The playbook library, one per trigger: what a CSM does on a dormant account, a solo user, a stalled onboarding, a cancellation notice, an approaching renewal. Written with the Content and Enablement Specialist and kept current from what the queue teaches you

- The save lane: cancellation and non-renewal signals routed to a person, the reason captured on every one, and the fixable ones fixed

- The expansion hand-off: when the team surfaces seat headroom or a buying signal, the account goes to the account executive working the scaled lanes, with the context they need to close

- The team's readout: queue volume by trigger, time to first response, time to resolution, configuration movement, and retention of covered accounts, built with the Success Analytics Engineer and read monthly

- Capacity: how many accounts one person on the queue can carry, measured from the queue, and the case for extending pooled coverage further down the base as triggers and playbooks mature

YOUR FIRST QUARTER

- Hire the first pooled customer success managers

- Define the trigger set, the response standard for each trigger, and get the queue live i

title: Hospitalists and Family Medicine Physicians: AI Diagnosis Review
description:
WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're hiring hospitalists and family medicine physicians to help us evaluate the accuracy of clinical AI tools. This research feeds directly into improving how algorithms suggest diagnoses based on patient charts. Your medical expertise will help determine where AI models succeed and where they fall short in real-world clinical scenarios.

HOW IT WORKS

You will review a series of de-identified patient records through our remote platform. For each case, you will form your own clinical diagnosis based on the provided chart. Next, you will review diagnoses proposed by an AI model and state whether you agree or disagree with its conclusions. The project requires a commitment of at least five hours to complete the assigned reviews.

WHO THIS IS FOR

This opportunity is for active physicians who are comfortable reviewing general medical cases. We welcome licensed hospitalists, family medicine physicians, and general internal medicine practitioners. You should have strong experience in chart review and differential diagnosis generation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review de-identified patient charts and medical records

- Generate your own clinical diagnosis for each assigned case

- Evaluate AI-proposed diagnoses for accuracy and clinical relevance

- Dedicate a minimum of five hours to complete the case reviews

WHO SHOULD APPLY

- Active medical license in the US

- Practicing hospitalist or family medicine physician

- Strong background in generating differential diagnoses

- Available to complete remote chart reviews between September 24 and 27

COMPENSATION

$200 per hour

title: Revenue Operations Architect — GTM Systems Builder
description:
Level AI · Remote (US) · Reports to the CRO
About Level AI

Level AI is building the LLM-native platform for customer experience. We process 100% of contact center interactions in real time to power automated QA, real-time agent assist, Voice of the Customer, and voice/chat AI agents - used by companies like Affirm, Penske, Carta, and OpenTable. We’re Series C, scaling fast, and rebuilding our GTM engine to match the ambition of the product.
About the Role
This is a builder role and a manager role. You’ll spend your days in Salesforce, in Gong, and in Claude - designing systems and shipping them, not only running a team or maintaining a process someone else defined. Most of the infrastructure doesn’t exist yet. You’ll design it, build it, own it, and prove it works before anyone else has to adopt it.
If you’re energized by a blank canvas and shipping real systems - and you’ve built one, ideally with AI in the loop - we want to talk. If you’ve only maintained a machine someone else built, this isn’t the fit.
What You’ll Build
The forecast and deal engine

• A simplified, high-accuracy forecast off two sources only - Gong + Salesforce - on a MEDDICC-based commit/best-case structure with a +/-5% accuracy target and a weekly CRO cadence.

• The deal desk: pricing guardrails, discount authority, and quote governance - built to move fast without leaking margin.

• Territory and quota models: capacity planning, attainment tracking, and clean routing logic owned in Salesforce.

GTM engineering & signal intelligence

• The signal layer: product usage and intent data routed into a scored queue for BDRs and AEs.

• GTM AI agents you architect and ship - research, sequencing, forecasting, and daily pipeline briefings - productionized, not prototyped.

• An ICP scoring model that sharpens itself as deal data compounds.

The CRO’s operating system

• A live executive dashboard: pipeline coverage, conversion, ramp velocity, NRR, and forecast accuracy - self-serve, not a weekly manual pull.

• The systems and data hygiene that make every number above trustworthy.

GTM execution

• Own cross-functional GTM projects end to end (pricing changes, launches, new-segment entry) with named owners and a clear definition of done on every line.

• Partner with Marketing to keep one pipeline definition and one source of truth - no parallel systems, no competing data.

What You’ll Need

• 6+ years in RevOps, GTM engineering, or sales strategy at high-growth B2B SaaS/AI - ideally through the $20M-$100M ARR scaling phase.

• Hands-on builder. You’ve personally built forecasts, routing logic, deal-desk rules, dashboards, or GTM automations - not just directed a team that did.

• Deep, working fluency in Salesforce and Gong; strong analytical and systems-design instincts.

• A bias toward shipping and finishing: you scope tightly, deliver, and close the loop rather than leaving projects at 80%.

• Comfort building with AI tooling (Claude, agents, LLM-driven workflows) as a core part of the stack, not a novelty.

• Able to influence a tenured, change-resistant seller base by proving value first, then driving adoption.

Nice to Have

• CPQ / Salesforce architecture depth.

• Experience with outbound data infrastructure (enrichment, sequencing, intent).

• Enterprise sales motion and complex-deal support.

This is a zero-to-one, builder-first role. If you want to run a team, this isn’t it. If you want to build the system a great team will run on,

About Stonebranch :
Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration. No matter the degree of automation, the Stonebranch platform is simple, modern, and secure. Using Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC), enterprises can seamlessly orchestrate workloads and data across hybrid IT environments. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with points of contact and support throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Stonebranch serves some of the world’s largest financial, manufacturing, healthcare, travel, transportation, energy, and technology institutions.
Your Part in this Growth Story:
Stonebranch is searching for an ABAP Technical Lead to own the technical direction of BatchMan, our SAP-native workload automation product. We want someone who takes full accountability for a business-critical codebase and moves it forward without waiting to be told what to build next. BatchMan runs inside SAP as an add-on. It extends SAP's native job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation for more than 160 customers, ranging from long-established SAP enterprises to early technology adopters. The architecture decisions you make will shape how the product performs, evolves, and serves those customers for years to come.
This is a role built for where engineering is heading. We are transforming BatchMan development to an AI-first, specification-driven approach, and you'll lead that transformation. Using Claude Code as your primary AI agent, you'll write the technical specifications that drive development, then direct and verify AI-generated code with the senior judgment to catch what the AI gets wrong. That leaves your deepest focus for architecture and the hard technical decisions. On a codebase with more than 15 years of history, that judgment matters most. Knowing where classic ABAP and modern ABAP differ, and where the critical details hide, is what makes AI a force multiplier rather than a risk.
You'll join a small, focused team made up of an experienced fellow developer, AI agents, and the Senior Product Manager who owns the product. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. You will, however, make the high-level architecture decisions for BatchMan and set the engineering standards the codebase is built against. You'll also be the escalation point for our Customer Support team on complex technical issues, and you'll work directly with customers when an escalation calls for it. Because our customer base is largely German-speaking, business-fluent German is required.
Deep, hands-on ABAP expertise is essential. That includes experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on, not only customer-specific extensions. What sets you apart is ownership: the drive to make this product yours and keep it strong over the long term.
This is a remote position open to candidates based anywhere in EMEA, with a preference for candidates located near a Stonebranch office. Quarterly travel to our EMEA headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany or our Honico office in Hamburg, Germany is required. This role reports directly to the Senior Product Manager.

title: Senior Product Manager, Messaging Platform & AI Services
description:
At ASAPP , our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience-faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job-it’s a journey.
You will own the surface where humans and AI work together to serve customers - the messaging platform, the Virtual Agent and the channels it runs on, and the AI Services that make every human agent faster and every automated conversation better. This is one of the largest product surfaces at ASAPP , and it is where the promise of AI-native customer experience is proven or lost.
You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans the Messaging Platform, Virtual Agent, the messaging and voice channels (Web, iOS, Android, Apple Messages for Business, RCS etc), and the AI Services that sit underneath them - AI-assisted human augmentation tools. You will become the go-to expert on this domain, internally and externally, and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders.
The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves - as automation absorbs more of the conversation and the line between human and AI work keeps moving. The strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target, and will bring the technical and customer depth to anticipate what the right target is as AI develops in the space.
What You Will Do

You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely.

• Own the Messaging Platform - the application where live agents handle concurrent conversations, access customer context and knowledge, and collaborate with AI. Own the roadmap for agent productivity and the human side of every AI-assisted interaction.

• Define and execute the Virtual Agent and channels roadmap. Own how customers deploy automated conversations across Web, mobile SDKs, Apple Messages for Business, WhatsApp, RCS and voice, and how those channels stay coherent as the platform grows.

• Lead the AI Services that power the surface - such as automatic conversation summary, voice-to-text transcription and AI-augmented response generation. Own how these services improve agent handle time, quality, and compliance, and decide where to invest as model capabilities change. Reason directly about accuracy, latency, and trust tradeoffs rather than treating them as engineering-only concerns.

• Be the go-to expert on Human + AI collaboration. Represent this surface to customers and account teams, translate their pain into a prioritized roadmap, and be the internal source of truth on how these products work and where they are going.

• Own the external documentation for this surface as part of the product. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them.
Across all of these areas:

• Set strategy and own the roadmap - balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets.

• Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery.

• Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage customer asks with product evolution bets; say no with clarity and evidence.

• Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven

description:
Rust Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Rust Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $145,000-$205,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Rust Developer to design, build, and optimize high-performance distributed systems, low-latency backend services, and cloud-native infrastructure components powering mission-critical enterprise platforms. This role focuses on developing highly concurrent, memory-safe applications using Rust while integrating with modern cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and event-driven architectures.
You will work closely with platform engineers, distributed systems architects, DevOps teams, and product engineering groups to build scalable APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, networking services, and infrastructure automation tools. The ideal candidate has strong systems programming expertise, deep knowledge of concurrent application development, and experience building production software where performance, reliability, and security are critical.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop high-performance backend services using Rust for large-scale distributed systems.

• Build low-latency APIs, asynchronous processing services, and event-driven microservices.

• Develop networking applications utilizing TCP, UDP, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets, and QUIC protocols.

• Build highly concurrent applications using Rust's async ecosystem including Tokio and async/await.

• Design resilient services capable of processing millions of transactions with high availability and fault tolerance.

• Optimize CPU utilization, memory management, thread scheduling, and application performance.

• Integrate services with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.

• Develop secure APIs and authentication services supporting OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect, and mTLS.

• Build observability capabilities including structured logging, distributed tracing, and performance monitoring.

• Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, system design discussions, and production support.

• Collaborate with DevOps engineers to automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.

• Investigate complex production issues involving networking, concurrency, memory utilization, and distributed systems.

Required Skills

• Six or more years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise applications.

• Three or more years of hands-on Rust development experience in production environments.

• Strong proficiency in Rust programming language, ownership model, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, and macros.

• Extensive experience with asynchronous Rust development using Tokio, async/await, Futures, and Actix or Axum.

• Strong understanding of concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization primitives, and lock-free programming concepts.

• Experience building RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and high-performance backend applications.

• Strong understanding of operating system fundamentals including memory management, process scheduling, file systems, and networking.

• Experience working with Linux production environments and command-line tooling.

• Experience developing cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

• Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.

• Experience working with NoSQL databases such as Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or Mon

title: Offering Tools Finance Lead
description:

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Offering Tools Finance Lead

Purpose

Everpure is looking for a Business Case Finance Lead to build the financial models behind customer business cases. You will build CFO-grade, repeatable and standardised value logic for products across Everpure's portfolio, and own the assumptions, benchmarks and inputs that keep those models accurate. The models feed directly into our wider automated sales operating model, so sellers everywhere present customers with the same credible, defensible numbers.

These models will underpin the proposals used across the entire sales organisation, and form the core of the business cases that go in front of customers. They will cover a wide range of deal sizes, products and industries, so they need to be consistent, robust and adaptable.

The role has three parts:

• Identify the value. Understand how each product creates measurable value for customers, across cost efficiency, growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build the model. Convert that value into a repeatable, standardised financial model, including cash flow, P&L and return metrics, that works across accounts and deal sizes.

• Tell the financial story. Translate the model and its outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that increases the impact of every proposal with customers, including their CFOs and finance teams.

What Success Looks Like

• Credible, robust and accurate financial models underpin the portfolio of Everpure products.

• Models are repeatable and standardised, and can be fed into customer proposals through our wider automated operating model.

• Models and financials are translated into a compelling financial narrative that resonates with customers, including CFOs and finance teams.

• Governance is in place around model inputs, with assumptions validated, updated and maintained.

• Existing models are continually refined as new data is collected and new products are released.

What You'll Be Doing

Value and Financial Models

• Identify how each product creates measurable value for customers across the key value levers: cost efficiency, revenue growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build CFO-grade financial models, including cash flow and P&L, for each product across the portfolio.

• Standardise models around common inputs and outputs, so they can be repeated efficiently and consistently across accounts and products.

• Apply a consistent methodology and accounting treatment, with ROI, TCO, NPV, IRR and payback calculated the same way every time.

• Continuously improve model accuracy, and develop new, financially robust ways to quantify value.

Financial Narrative

• Translate model outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that shows customers what the investment means for their business.

• Turn complex financial results into tangible measures that customers and sellers can relate to.

• Help sellers position the business case confidently, in executive language.

Assumptions, Inputs and Governance

• Own, govern and maintain the global assumptions, benchmarks and financial inputs feeding the models.

• Identify and add the new pricing, product advances and market trends the models need, within an agreed SLA.

• Define the source, owner and refresh cadence for every input, and maintain a clear version history.

• Reconcile model outputs against real deals to check accuracy over time.

• Work on malicious actors prevention and mitigation.

• You are driven by curiosity to explore and master new technologies and concepts.

Mandatory

• Hands-on GCP: Vertex AI, GKE and BigQuery in production, not only as skill tags.

• Kubernetes depth: you've run and debugged clusters yourself, not just deployed to them.

• GitOps for infrastructure (Config Sync or similar) and CI/CD for model deployment.

• Python to production standard, including tests and packaging.

• Proven platform thinking: you've built tooling other teams self-serve on, with docs and SLOs.

• Comfortable working independently as the single owner of a company-wide platform.

Nice-to-have

• Streaming features or online inference with Dataflow/Flink and Kafka.

• Feature stores (Vertex AI Feature Store, Feast) and model monitoring tooling.

• LLM serving and evaluation on Vertex AI or similar.

• Prior experience in high-scale consumer products.

Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Senior Web Developer (UI & API Integration) to lead front-end development and API integration for a federal environmental platform. You will design and implement user interface updates that enable federal users to access new species data for regulatory consultations, ensuring full Section 508 accessibility compliance throughout. This is a fully remote position.
The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species .
Work Location: Remote
Day to Day Responsibilities:

• Lead platform user interface updates to display new species data alongside existing species, including habitat designations, listing status, and regulatory requirements

• Design and implement the updated geographic query interface for marine and coastal query types

• Develop and integrate authorized API connections between the platform front-end and the cloud data layer

• Ensure all UI changes comply with Section 508/WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility standards, coordinating with QA Engineers for DHS Trusted Tester Methodology accessibility testing

• Produce Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) using VPAT Version 2.4 Rev 508 for all UI updates

• Update the consultation package builder front-end to support new content generation and joint agency consultation package assembly

• Contribute to the IPaC UI and Logic Update Package, delivering all front-end UI components, geographic query interface updates, and consultation package builder enhancements with accompanying VPAT documentation for government review

• Support the demo environment setup for government demonstrations, ensuring the UI is stable and demo-ready

• Implement UI updates based on live consultation feedback from production

Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of experience, Master’s degree and 3 years of experience, Associate’s degree and 7 years of experience, HS Diploma and 9 years of experience.

• U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.

• 5 plus years of web development experience with a focus on federal application front-end development.

• Proficiency in React, Angular, or equivalent modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Proficiency in HTML5 and CSS3 for accessible, standards-compliant federal web application development.

• Deep expertise in Section 508/WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility standards and DHS Trusted Tester Methodology.

• Experience producing VPAT 2.4 Rev 508 Access

title: Construction Superintendent, Fluid/Mechanical - Memphis
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

CONSTRUCTION SUPERINTENDENT, FLUID/MECHANICAL

Most construction jobs manage someone else’s crew on someone else’s schedule, then end when the project does. This one does not.

SpaceX builds its own launch sites, factories, test stands, and AI superclusters - and it plans to keep building. The rockets, the chips, and the missions only matter if the ground under them is real. Construction is how that ground gets built, in-house and to a standard the company can actually use. The work does not dry up between jobs. There is a next site, and one after that. You lead the crew that builds them.

You own a self-performing team. Foremen run their people day to day. You run the foremen. You are in the dirt, walking the work, setting the bar, and clearing whatever is in the way. When someone is ready for more, you say so. When the standard slips, you deal with it.

Scope includes, but not limited to industrial HVAC, pipefitting, pipe welding, chilled water, cooling towers, chillers, condensers, CRAC and CRAH units, and setting that heavy mechanical equipment. It also includes all plumbing: domestic water, sanitary, drain-waste-vent, and floor drains. It includes all fire protection: sprinkler fitting, suppression, and pre-action. This is the work that moves heat, water, and fire protection through the building.

The team goes where the next site is - a pad, a factory, a supercluster, whatever has to exist before the rest of the company can move. Right now that is Memphis, TN / Southaven, MS. Then it is the next one. Per diem comes with the assignment.

• Set clear expectations for safety, quality, schedule, and conduct, and hold foremen and crews accountable when those expectations are missed

• Remove roadblocks so crews can keep working: materials, access, sequencing, coordination with other trades, and decisions

• Recommend promotions, role changes, and corrective action based on performance

• Plan and run the night-shift assignment, including extended hours, as part of a 24/7 operation

• Keep fluid and mechanical installations on SpaceXSI’s quality and reliability standards, including code compliance and system integrity required for data center cooling and fire protection

• Track daily progress and maintain logs, red-line drawings, and as-built documentation for mechanical, plumbing, and fire-protection systems

• Build and hold an aggressive construction schedule, on time and within budget

• Champion SpaceXSI’s safety program and a zero-incident culture around pressure piping, hot work, rigging and setting heavy mechanical equipment, and work at heights

• Resolve on-site issues - material delays, technical conflicts, sequencing, and trade coordination - with attention to system integrity and code compliance

title: Lead Digital Product Designer
description:
Position Overview
We are seeking a dynamic and talented Lead Digital Product Designer who can apply expertise in user experience design, visual design, and digital strategy to create and execute design solutions that meet the client’s business goals. Our ideal candidate understands how people think, operate, and interact with complex sets of data and is comfortable working with designers, developers, data analysts, and product managers to design the user experience for digital products. We are looking for someone who is competent in all aspects of the design process, bring Lean UX methods and strategic thinking into enterprise projects, and establish and grow relationships with clients.
Responsibilities
Engagement Delivery and Management

• Serving in lead capacity on large, complex projects, create user experiences and visual design strategies and solutions for projects based on business objectives and user research

• Serve as subject matter expert in the defined UX and brand standards and the execution of visual, interaction, and motion design

• Facilitate internal team communication, bridging the gap between visual design, functional development, and content

• Communicate the value of UX, UI, and design thinking to clients

• Lead client engagements from a UX perspective

• Lead participatory design activities, e.g., client workshops, card sorting, to understand vision, business model, and user needs and behaviors

• Serve as the voice of the user while meeting the needs of the client

• Combine UX thinking with design execution to produce usable and intuitive user interfaces

• Illustrate user experience using storyboards, information architecture, process flows, user journeys/personas, and sitemaps

• Use design to communicate complex concepts, whether through conversations, frameworks, or ideas

• Derive actionable insights by leading user research activities and translating insights into prototypes

• Provide coaching and guidance to other product designers on the team to elevate our approach to user experience research and design and promote the craft of UX across the organization

• Collaborate with architects, developers, and project teams to ensure design elements are incorporated into development sprints

• Proactively perform competitive research based on product roadmaps

• Plan and facilitate interactive workshops to build consensus around business requirements and design ideas

Design Team Leadership

• Lead the design team in best practices, design trends, and leading technologies

• Support the development and adoption of design processes, tools, and culture

• Develop, refine, and adhere to design systems and style guides

• Understand and incorporate Design Thinking, Agile Methodologies, Lean Principles and Collective Intelligence into project strategy

Necessary Skills

• Strong understanding of foundational design principles including type, layout, use of color, etc.

• Deep understanding of user experience best practices and the latest UI trends, techniques, and technologies

• Understanding of desktop, mobile web, native iOS and Android platforms, and the ability to provide recommendation when it's best to follow platform-specific conventions.

• Ability to collaboratively go from whiteboard, to sketch, to high fidelity prototype, to live product

• Ability to conduct and apply customer research, including design thinking and rapid prototyping

• Outstanding facilitation, brainstorming, and collaboration skills

• Extensive experience with standard design tools, e.g., Axure, Sketch, Adobe XD, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc.

• Excellent visual design skills with sensitivity to user-system interaction

• Excellent communication, presentation and critical thinking skills.

• Strong sense of collaboration; able to thrive in iterative, cross-disciplinary environments

• Ability to drive consensus via facilitation, storytelling, and brainstorming

• Comfortable trying new things and failing

Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

 

Role Summary

Join the team behind the fan experience at Fanatics Collectibles! This is your chance to gain hands-on experience, contribute to real-world projects, and help us create cutting-edge packaging that excites fans around the globe!

• Assist Packaging Engineers in preparing packaging specifications/BOM’s and developing new packaging configurations.

• Provide overall support for the package engineering team in their day-to-day duties.

Requirements

• Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Engineering, Packaging Science, or a related field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Familiarity with packaging design principles and materials.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with ArtiosCAD software is a plus.

 

Please note that this is an in-office role located in our Dallas, TX offices.

title: Research Engineer, Benchmarks & Evaluation
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT RAMP LABS

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 70,000+ companies use to move money. We think the defensible part of an AI product is the loop: proprietary environments, evals that track what customers care about, and models trained against both.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every model decision at Ramp Labs runs through a benchmark. Which model to route to. Whether a post-training run worked. Whether an agent is ready to post a corrective journal entry to a customer's ledger without a human in the loop.

You'll own Ramp's benchmarking effort. You'll turn real finance work (expense policy review, invoice coding, month-end close, spreadsheet Q&A) into benchmarks and RL environments, build the graders, and tell the team what is actually improving.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build benchmarks from real workflows: turn agent traces, customer edge cases and expert labels into versioned benchmark suites for long-horizon agents that run for hours across tools and systems, plus tool use, multi-step reasoning and financial judgment

- Own the benchmarking effort: decide what we measure, run benchmark suites across models and agent versions, and report results the team makes decisions on

- Design graders: rubrics, programmatic checks and llm-as-judge, calibrated against human agreement, with a clear view of where each one breaks

- Close the loop with post-training: turn evals into reward functions and RL environments, and catch reward hacking and contamination before they ship

- Publish external benchmarks and write-ups on how models perform at real finance work

WHAT YOU NEED

- Hands-on experience building LLM benchmarks or evals that people used to make real decisions

- Strong Python and software engineering; your eval code is reproducible and fast

- Statistical judgment: variance, confidence intervals, sample size, inter-rater agreement, and knowing when a delta is noise

- Working knowledge of post-training (SFT, RL with verifiable rewards) and how evals feed into it

- Comfort with SQL and large datasets; you'll work directly from production traces

- Taste for what is worth measuring

NICE-TO-HAVE

- Industry experience on an eval, benchmarking or post-training team

- Built RL environments or verifiers for agentic tasks

- Published benchmark or evaluation research (NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks, ICML, ACL)

- Built or contributed to eval frameworks (verifiers, lm-evaluation-harness, HELM or similar)

- Familiarity with accounting, finance or other expert-domain work

- Public work we can look at: a benchmark, an eval suite, a failure-analysis write-up

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual

title: Senior Safety Domain Expert - Falcon
description:
Job Title: Senior Safety Domain Expert - Falcon
Job Location: Boston, MA
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to serve as our Senior Safety Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. This role bridges ground-level case execution with macro-level safety operations, using your deep knowledge of case processing, MedDRA coding, database reconciliation, and global compliance to inform our AI driven automation tools. You will spend your days collaborating with our internal technical teams and external early adopters, acting as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to ensure our platform delivers flawless safety automation.
What You'll Do

•
End-to-End Workflow Guidance: Advise product and engineering teams on the detailed steps of safety case intake, triage, validation, and advanced data reconciliation workflows

•
Ground-Truth Verification: Actively review and verify platform outputs across initial data entry, automated MedDRA coding assignment, and generated follow-up queries to ensure absolute data precision

•
Early Adopter Engagement: Interact directly with PV leads and processing specialists at early adopter organizations, translating their feedback into actionable platform enhancements

•
Stress-Test Scenario Building: Map out highly complex, multi-variable safety case scenarios to rigorously evaluate and calibrate the platform's reasoning boundaries

Requirements

• 5+ years of active experience in Pharmacovigilance / Drug Safety Operations

• Extensive hands-on knowledge of the complete case lifecycle, including validation criteria, database reconciliation, and global expedited reporting timelines

• High proficiency with MedDRA coding rules and deep familiarity with mainstream safety databases (e.g., Veeva Safety, Argus, ArisG)

• Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to confidently present operational perspectives to non-clinical technical partners and customers

Nice to Have

• Prior experience contributing to the design, implementation, or user-acceptance testing (UAT) of automated pharmacovigilance intake solutions

• Prior experience with, or a strong baseline curiosity about, agentic AI, automated workflows, or next-generation cloud platforms in clinical trials

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

• Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

title: M&A – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
description:
DEINE ROLLE

Die Steuerberatung erlebt eine Konsolidierungswelle: Tausende Häuser suchen in den nächsten Jahren eine Nachfolge, und nur wenige Käufer prüfen sie mit derselben Sorgfalt wie ein professionelles Transaktionsteam. Hier lernst du M&A auf der Käuferseite, an echten Transaktionen und von der ersten Ansprache bis nach dem Abschluss.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen und erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen, um sie weiterzuentwickeln. Wir prüfen laufend neue Ziele, bewerten, verhandeln und schließen ab. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss, sie fängt dort an.

Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master und willst den Transaktionsprozess vollständig kennenlernen, nicht nur einen Ausschnitt davon. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du arbeitest im Finance-Team und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung an laufenden Transaktionen.

DEINE VERANTWORTUNG

Zielsuche und Marktanalyse

- Du baust Longlists und Shortlists möglicher Ziele, recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Nachfolgesituationen und bereitest Erstansprachen vor.

- Du wertest Teaser und erste Unterlagen aus und hältst in einer kurzen Einschätzung fest, ob sich eine vertiefte Prüfung lohnt.

Bewertung und Due Diligence

- Du erstellst Bewertungen nach Multiplikatoren, Transaktionsvergleichen und Ertragswert, normalisierst Jahresabschlüsse und rechnest Kaufpreis-Mechanik und Sensitivitäten durch.

- Du strukturierst Datenräume, koordinierst Fragenlisten mit dem Verkäufer und unseren Beratern und benennst Auffälligkeiten für die Verhandlung.

- Du rechnest die Finanzierungsseite mit: Kapitaldienst, Rückbeteiligung, Zahlungsstruktur über die Zeit.

Verhandlung und Abschluss

- Du bereitest Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung vor: eine Empfehlung mit Begründung, keine Sammlung von Kennzahlen.

- Du arbeitest an Absichtserklärungen, Term Sheets und Verhandlungsunterlagen mit und begleitest Gespräche mit Inhabern.

- Nach dem Abschluss hilfst du, das übernommene Haus in unser Berichtswesen zu überführen, und machst sichtbar, ob die Annahmen der Bewertung eintreten.

DEINE PERSPEKTIVEN

Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast:

- Du hast an mindestens einer Transaktion durchgehend mitgearbeitet, von der Analyse bis zur Verhandlung.

- Ein Bewertungsmodell von dir ist in eine Entscheidungsvorlage eingegangen, und ein Dritter kann es weiterrechnen.

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

- Du trägst die Erstprüfung eines Ziels eigenständig, vom Teaser bis zur Empfehlung.

- Du kennst den Prozess so gut, dass du die nächste Prüfung strukturieren könntest.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Wer im Praktikum überzeugt, hat die Tür für den Einstieg in Finance & M&A offen. Fachliche Expertenlaufbahn und Führungslaufbahn stehen danach beide offen, entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Erfahrung & Track Record

- Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fach mit Vertiefung in Finance, Corporate Finance oder Rechnungswesen.

- Erste Praxis in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Private Equity oder einer Unternehmensberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

- Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Steuerfachangestellte mit laufendem Studium, die Jahresabschlüsse von innen kennen, Mathematik- oder Physikstudierende mit Interesse an Bewertung, Gründer eines eigenen kleinen Unternehmens. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

title: AI research scientist
description:
🚀 ABOUT WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

 
 

📐 ABOUT THE ROLE

AI research at WRITER isn't just about publishing papers - it's about building the scientific foundation that powers some of the most ambitious enterprise AI deployments in the world. As an AI research scientist, you'll be at the center of that work. You'll drive a high-impact research agenda focused on large language models, agentic reasoning, and the system-level capabilities that make AI genuinely useful at enterprise scale. This is a rare opportunity to do research that matters twice over - advancing the field and shipping directly into products used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.

We're at an inflection point. Enterprises are moving from experimenting with AI to deeply embedding it across their operations, and WRITER's models are the engine making that possible. The work you do here - on post-training, planning, multi-step reasoning, and agentic workflows - will directly shape how the next generation of enterprise AI behaves, performs, and scales. You'll have the resources, infrastructure, and cross-functional support to pursue ambitious ideas and bring them to life quickly. This role is hybrid, based out of our San Francisco or New York City hub.

You'll report to our VP of AI research. Please note: role is open to Senior, Staff, and Sr. Staff applicants

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

 
 

🦸🏻‍♀️ WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead an independent, high-impact research agenda on large language models and agentic systems, owning projects from early hypothesis through model training, evaluation, and production deployment

- Design and execute large-scale post-training experiments using supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), RLAIF, DPO, and emerging alignment techniques - with a focus on improving multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use in enterprise agentic workflows

- Build novel evaluation benchmarks and methodologies that push beyond existing limitations, establishing rigorous measures for how well models perform on complex, real-world enterprise tasks

- Develop scalable data synthesis and curation pipelines that generate the high-quality training signal driving model improvement - including LLM-as-judge frameworks, synthetic data generation, and adversarial dataset construction

- Shape WRITER's model architecture and training roadmap by translating your research insights into concrete improvements to our enterprise-grade LLMs, working hand-in-hand with research engineering and product teams

- Publish and present original research at top-tier venues - NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, and others - representing WRITER at the frontier of the field and contributing to the broader scientific community

- Mentor and uplevel fellow researchers and engineers on the team, helping set a high bar for scientific rigor, experimental design, and research culture

When an agency or billing company buys Logis Billing, the first months decide whether it trusts us. If the setup is right, claims go out clean and cash arrives on time. If it is wrong, claims reject, payments do not post, and the customer feels it in their bank account.
You take a customer from kickoff to their first clean billing cycle. You learn how they bill today, configure Logis Billing to match, move their data, train their staff, and stay with them through go-live until the money is moving. Then you hand them off cleanly to support and Customer Success.
Where we are headed
Logis Billing is growing, and AI agents are already taking repetitive work off billing teams. Every new customer is a chance to set them up for that future from day one.
You will implement for agencies and billing companies of every size, and help shape the playbook as the product changes.
Who ESO is
ESO is the first responder for the first responders. We build software and data products for EMS agencies, fire departments, hospitals, and government stakeholders, and serve more than 18,000 customers. Our mission is to improve community health and safety outcomes through the power of data.
How you support the mission
You support the mission by making sure agencies can collect what they are owed, so they can keep crews on the road and equipment in service. A clean go-live protects their revenue and their trust in us.
You support your team by doing it the same way every time: following the playbook, writing down what you learn, and asking for help early when a project starts to slip.

Run each implementation

• Plan and check data conversions, so open balances and history arrive correct.

• Run the user acceptance test (UAT) checklist with the customer and get sign-off before go-live.
Train and hand off

• Train the customer's billers and office staff on the workflows they will use every day.

• Stay with the customer through their first billing cycles until claims and payments are flowing.

• Hand off cleanly: Logis Billing support in Customer Care owns tickets, and Customer Success owns the relationship.
Time tracking

• Log your time in real time, as you finish each issue or task, in the time tracking system, by customer and type of work.
How success is measured

• Time to value: days from kickoff to the customer's first clean billing cycle, against the standard for the project size.

• Go-lives on the date in the project plan, and right the first time, with no serious defect in the first 30 days.

• Every project plan current each week: dates, health, and next steps.

• Customer satisfaction (CSAT) at go-live and at handoff.

• Time logged in real time and completely, to the team standard.

• Global & Diverse Team: You will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals from 24+ countries across the world, in a multicultural and collaborative environment.

• Global Impact: You’ll be part of a team shaping the future of global FinTech and stablecoin accessibility.

Our hiring process is virtual and is designed to be fast, fair, and respectful of your time.

• Stage 1: 15-minute TA screen

• Stage 2: 30-minute interview with the Sales Operations Manager

• Stage 3: 45-minute interview with the Executive VP of Business Development

• Stage 4: 30-minute final interview with the Chief Operating Officer

• Stage 5: Offer

You'll run discovery with engineers and executives, build demos that land, design and run workshops and proofs of concept, and make the technical case for Exa against alternatives. - Handle technical objections and answer security, compliance, and architecture questions

- Bring in Forward Deployed Engineers as specialists when a deal needs deeper expertise, and run a clean handoff to them after close

- Feed market signal back to Product: what prospects ask for, where we lose, and what would help us win

- Build reusable presales assets such as demo environments, reference architectures, and evaluation playbooks

- Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build compelling demos, implement POCs end to end, and design and run rigorous evals in head-to-head competitive scenarios

- 2+ years of hands-on presales or technical sales experience, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company. You've owned the technical side of deals, run discovery and demos with technical buyers, and helped carry opportunities to close

- Strong communication skills: you can adapt your pitch to CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike, and explain complex technology simply

- Track record of high performance in demanding environments, whether that's a top CS program, a competitive sport, a startup, or something else entirely

- High tolerance for context-switching, ambiguity, and sustained intensity

- Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and workshops

- Have worked as a solutions architect, solutions engineer, or sales engineer at a developer-tools, API, or AI company

- Have built with LLMs, RAG, or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

- Have helped close revenue or driven commercial outcomes at a previous company

- Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

title: Senior Strategic Finance Manager (Corporate Finance)
description:
About the Team

Netlify's Finance team builds the financial foundation that helps the company plan, operate, and make informed decisions. The team owns our operating model, management reporting, budgeting and planning, and the company-level metrics leadership uses to understand performance and make tradeoffs.

As Senior Finance Manager, you'll own the corporate finance cycle and decide what it should become. That covers monthly reporting, the driver-based forecast, annual planning, scenario work, and the KPI layer, and it extends past running them well into bringing your experience to improve and innovate on our processes. This is a hands-on role with real latitude: you will work directly with senior leadership on capital, pricing, and headcount decisions, and will leverage AI to build better tooling and make Finance faster and less dependent on manual work.

What You'll Do

• Own the corporate finance cycle end to end, including the monthly reporting package, the driver-based forecast, annual planning, and scenario analysis, and redesign the parts that no longer hold up as we scale

• Frame which scenarios are worth running ahead of capital, pricing, and headcount decisions, and bring a recommendation rather than a set of outputs

• Lead the annual planning process across departments, from calendar and templates through consolidation and board-ready output

• Lead cross-functional alignment on metric definitions, reporting dimensions and financial data hygiene

• Own the company-level KPI and metrics layer, decide what leadership measures as the business evolves, and carry a view on the trends driving each metric

• Drive market and competitor research to support pricing and packaging, capital allocation, and improve financial forecasting

• Communicate complex financial mechanics to people outside finance, and drive cross-functional decisions and leadership buy-in

• Set how budget management runs across departments, including the cadence and what a department leader is accountable for, rather than tracking it on their behalf

• Be a thought leader steering the finance function's AI operating standard and build the systems and agents to support it

• Partner with Sales leadership on capacity model and KPI tracking

What You'll Bring

• 7+ years in FP&A or strategic finance, including several years at a SaaS or usage-based business. An investment banking, consulting or private equity background preferred; but strong modeling skills, ability to develop frameworks to solve complex problems and ability to run scenarios is a must

• Multiple annual planning cycles owned end to end

• A history of building 3-statement models from scratch, with scenario and sensitivity analysis, and of making structural changes to a model rather than only updating inputs

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and core accounting principles

• Advanced Google Sheets or Excel, and comfort with large datasets and formula-heavy models

• Comfort framing abstract business problems and creating frameworks to address them

• Deep system-level understanding of how financial data moves across source systems, the warehouse, and the planning and reporting layer

• Deep command of SaaS metrics and their drivers, with a point of view on which ones actually matter at our stage

• Working knowledge of SQL

• Hands-on experience building AI workflows other teams adopt, and a clear view on where the human checks belongs

• Experience presenting analysis and recommendations to executive staff, and a track record of driving org level impact

• Deep curiosity about our business, product, customers, competitors and industry trends

• You want to own a function, not contribute to one. The corporate finance cycle would be yours to run and to redesign.
